# AIfy Solutions

> AIfy Solutions is a company in Surrey, BC, Canada that designs and builds custom AI and automation for businesses anywhere: AI chatbots and receptionists, AI voice agents for dealership service departments, workflow automation, GEO / AEO (generative and answer engine optimisation, including a free AI visibility check at https://aify.solutions/ai-visibility), website development, AI analytics and local SEO. Contact: info@aify.solutions.

## Pages

- [AIfy Solutions](https://aify.solutions/): AIfy designs and builds AI that answers your phones, follows up with customers and gets you found. Try our live AI service desk demo.
- [Live demo: AI service desk for dealerships](https://aify.solutions/demo): Call our AI service desk from your browser and watch it answer, book, text the customer and brief the advisor, live.
- [Free AI visibility check: does AI recommend your business?](https://aify.solutions/ai-visibility): Free GEO / AEO check: see whether AI assistants with live web search name your business when customers ask, who they recommend instead, and what to fix.
- [AI voice agent for dealership service](https://aify.solutions/dealerships): Every service call, answered. AIfy books into your schedule, handles "is my car ready?" and brings back customers who are due. Try the live demo.
- [Solutions](https://aify.solutions/solutions): AI chatbot and receptionist, workflow automation, GEO, website development, AI analytics and local SEO, built around your business.
- [How we work](https://aify.solutions/how-we-work): From first call to live in weeks: discovery, a fixed-price proposal, build and test, then launch and improve.
